discover_cluster.name: Discover Cluster Controllers
discover_cluster.description: Query a known controller's /hosts endpoint and add missing peers.

save_preset.name: Save current color as preset
save_preset.description: Save or update a controller-local preset from its current color.

scan_wifi.name: Scan Wi-Fi networks
scan_wifi.description: Start a Wi-Fi scan on the selected controller.

create_light.name: Create light
create_light.description: Create a firmware 5.1 light from a name, type and unused GPIO pins.

delete_light.name: Delete light
delete_light.description: Permanently delete a firmware 5.1 light by UUID.

connect_wifi.name: Connect to Wi-Fi
connect_wifi.description: Connect the selected controller to a Wi-Fi network.

user.title: Lightinator
user.description: Connect to an ESP RGBWW Lightinator device.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Discovered Lightinator
zeroconf_confirm.description: Found **{name}** at `{host}`. Do you want to add it?

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device. Check the IP address and that the device is reachable.

abort.not_lightinator: The device did not respond as a Lightinator.

hardware.title: Board and PWM settings
hardware.description: Choose the physical board and PWM parameters shared by all lights. Existing lights, GPIOs, buttons and I2C are preserved, not remapped by board selection. Assignments must be valid for the selected board. Changing PWM can interrupt outputs; unsupported frequency/resolution combinations can prevent outputs from starting. Older firmware may require a restart.

create_light.title: Create light
create_light.description: Create a firmware light and its HA entities. The first light is automatically the default.

light_pins.title: Light GPIOs
light_pins.description: Enter unused PWM GPIOs, not physical board pin numbers. {channels}. Board reservations, buttons, I2C and other lights must not overlap.

delete_light.title: Delete light
delete_light.description: Permanently removes the selected firmware light. HA entities remain unavailable to preserve automation identities. Select a replacement default only when deleting the default with other lights remaining. Deleting the final light is allowed.

color.title: Color settings
color.description: These values are saved together. Changing the output model reboots the controller.

network.title: Network settings
network.description: DHCP, IP address, netmask, and gateway are sent in one update. Leave secret fields blank to keep saved credentials.

firmware.title: Firmware updates
firmware.description: Choose the firmware branch and build type offered by the Lightinator version API.

icon.title: Controller icon
icon.description: Choose an icon from the controller's local sprite. The controller keeps this icon available offline.

abort.controller_not_loaded: This controller is not loaded. Check its integration setup error, host address and credentials, then reload the entry and try Configure again.
abort.no_lights: No lights are configured on this controller.

error.light_management_failed: Could not apply the light configuration. Check GPIO assignments and the default light; reopen Configure if the configuration changed. See the HA log for details.
error.hardware_configuration_failed: Could not load or apply hardware settings. Check the board, pin assignments and PWM values; reopen Configure if settings changed. See the HA log for details.
error.confirmation_required: Confirm the requested change before continuing.
error.cannot_connect: Could not read or update the controller configuration.
error.invalid_network: Check that the static gateway is in the same subnet as the controller IP.
error.password_required: Enter an API password before enabling protection.
error.firmware_api_unavailable: Could not load firmware choices from the version API. Check the controller's OTA catalog URL and server availability.
error.firmware_combination_unavailable: No firmware is available for that branch and build type combination.
error.controller_icon_unavailable: Could not load or update the controller's local icon sprite.
